data.completion_memo: Implemented provider-neutral model gateway contracts that admit only the frozen allowed binding and enforce output bounds while keeping provider-native details behind ModelProvider. cargo check -p aworkit-capability-host passes.
data.description: Implement Aworkit-owned model request, streaming, usage, error, cancellation, and provider-selection contracts with the replaceable private provider/Rig seam. Resolve only candidates allowed by the frozen approved binding and keep provider-native request, session, and result types inside the adapter.
data.title: M05.3 — Implement the model and provider gateway
